bugs.title: Non-English source audio must be automatically translated to English - faster-whisper's transcribe/translate task distinction is not wired at all
bugs.notes: Seeded from sweep prompt. FasterWhisperTranscriber (pipeline/stage_a/transcribe.py) only passes `language` to model.transcribe(), never `task` - so it always runs task="transcribe" (stays in source language) and never translates. Required fix: (1) add a task mode ("transcribe" | "translate_to_english") wired to faster-whisper's own task="transcribe"/"translate" values; (2) when task=translate, language must be None (auto-detect) so Whisper identifies the real source language; (3) make translate+auto-detect the DEFAULT end-to-end (bot/src/github.js buildStageARequest options.language fallback, transcribe.py defaults, .github/workflows/stage-a.yml fallbacks, schemas/stage_a_request.schema.json default) unless an explicit preserve-original-language option exists (check first); (4) update transcribe.py CLI: --lang accepts "auto"-equivalent mapping to language=None, add --task defaulting to "translate", keep "transcribe" available; (5) persist into transcript.json both the task actually run AND the actually-detected source language + probability (info.language / info.language_probability, currently only logged ~line 156-160); (6) verify empirically with a non-English sample (English transcript out, detected source language recorded) AND an English sample (unchanged correct transcript under task=translate); (7) update existing pipeline tests touching language_hint / transcribe CLI / transcript.json shape, and add unit coverage for task-selection logic without requiring a real model download.
